identification: 18ct gold diamond cluster/halo ring (catalogue: 18ct white gold), modern engagement style: a small round brilliant centre diamond in a cluster of small round diamonds inside a square double halo, with three channel-set baguette diamonds on each shoulder, in a cream ring box.
